objective: Test the otherwise-qualified continuous public stream with the smallest evidence-supported clock-order correction: an explicit one-second source-clock-ahead tolerance.
pass_gate: VALID quality with recorded signed skew not exceeding one second; all required channels and controls; no unexplained connection-global gap/out-of-order/conflict; deterministic replay/restart/corruption/compactness/resource gates; zero external effect.
failure_gate: Clock lead exceeds one second, any other data/replay/recovery/integrity/bound gate fails, previous attempts mutate, or authentication/account/order/signer/wallet/capital access occurs.
scope_limit: Public spread/depth distribution and evidence-plane qualification only; no fee tier, order latency, rejection, partial-fill, actual-fill, economic-edge, capital, or live qualification.
